raw_response:
I am 65 years old and I have farmed my 4.1 mu in Quzhou County for 50 years. I only finished primary school, but I learned everything from my father and from watching what works in my own fields. I live alone now — my wife passed and my children work in the city — so every decision is mine and every cost comes from my own pocket.

For wheat, I will plant the whole 4.1 mu in early October with improved seed I buy from the village supply store. I need about 60 kg of seed for the whole plot, which is about 15 kg per mu. Before sowing, I will rotary till the field to break up the maize stubble. I will buy two and a half 50-kg bags of compound fertilizer, the 15-15-15 kind, and spread it as base dressing. That is about 30 kg per mu. Last year I topdressed with one and a half bags of urea at jointing time, and the wheat looked a little pale, so this year I will use two bags of urea — about 24 kg per mu. I would rather spend the extra money than risk a thin harvest. At my age, a bad year is hard to recover from. I will irrigate three times: wintering water after the seedlings come up, jointing water in March, and one more in late April if the rain does not come. Pumping costs electricity, but I cannot let the wheat dry out at heading. I will spray herbicide once in early spring and insecticide once if I see aphids. Two sprays total. If the weather is normal, I expect about 480 kg per mu.

For maize, I sow the whole 4.1 mu right after wheat harvest in mid-June. The window is short — only about a week — so I use no-tillage and plant straight into the wheat stubble, just like my neighbors do. I buy hybrid seed, about 8 kg total. At sowing, I put down two 50-kg bags of compound fertilizer, about 24 kg per mu. When the plants are knee-high in July, I spread one and a half bags of urea, about 18 kg per mu. I will irrigate twice: once right after sowing if the soil is dry, and once at the big trumpet stage in late July. If the summer rains are good, I might skip the first one. I spray herbicide once and insecticide once — two times total. I expect about 520 kg per mu if the autumn weather holds.

I watch what my neighbors do. The man across the road uses more fertilizer and hires labor, but he has three sons sending money home. I farm alone, so I must be careful with cash. Still, I do not dare cut the fertilizer too close. Hunger is worse than wasting a few yuan.
